title: Recalled abduction aboard a 50-foot craft and toe implantation
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Recalled abduction aboard a 50-foot craft and toe implantation, about unspecified at Fillmore, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um well they um two um uh gray small gray beings uh came into my room and um woke me up and said come outside.

plain: Steve Coburn told podcast host Jesse Michels that, in Fillmore, California, two small grey beings came into his room, woke him up and told him to come outside. He says he later remembered being taken aboard a craft about 50 feet across, where something was implanted in his toe. If true, it would mean beings put objects inside human bodies.
